messages:
incident-bot: Paging: latency alert for /v1/generate from us-east-1 cluster > p99 900ms :warning:
Sam (oncall): taking this, looking at dashboards now.
Nate: I see a spike in mean queue time on the continuous-batcher metric. batch_window_us jumped from ~8k to ~45k for many workers.
Priya: confirmed for us-east-1-a and -b. Throughput is steady but tail latency is climbing.
Marta: any changes to customer traffic shaping or new large customers?
Sam (oncall): checking routing logs... looks like a customer spike from LaunchPad (org: launchpad_prod). They started a long prompt fanout.
Nate: LaunchPad is on the high-throughput tier; we have per-org soft quota.
Sam (oncall): Incident plan: attempt live mitigation by increasing batching aggressiveness to reduce token compute cost per request and trade some latency for throughput. We'll also throttle non-critical endpoints (embeddings) for that org.
Priya: I prefer adjusting continuous_batch_window and max_batch_size on the serving layer before adding rate limits — should reduce CPU spikes quickly.
Marta: agree. What numbers? current batch_window_us=10000 (10ms), max_batch_size=32.
Nate: propose batch_window_us=50000 (50ms), max_batch_size=64 for affected workers; set a canary on 10% of workers first.
Sam (oncall): good. Also toggle streaming=false for LaunchPad requests to avoid incremental flush overhead.
Alex: I'll prepare commands. Doing a canary deploy to pool-us-east-1-b-small first.
Sam (oncall): annotate customer-impact and post a short note to support.
Priya: Support note draft: "We’re applying temporary batching optimizations to improve overall throughput; some requests for LaunchPad may see slightly higher p50/p90 latency but reduced errors. Investigating root cause"
Marta: add ETA: effect visible within ~1 minute after canary.
deploy-bot: starting rollout to pool-us-east-1-b-small (canary=10%). digest=sha256:abcd1234
Alex: canary in. Running infractl param-set --pool pool-us-east-1-b-small --param continuous_batch_window_us=50000 --param max_batch_size=64 --meta note="mitigation for high queue times"
Alex: output:
```
Applying params to pool-us-east-1-b-small... OK
Rolling config to 10% workers... OK
```
Sam (oncall): watching metrics — queue time dropping on canary workers, p99 latency down ~200ms.
Nate: good sign. Any errors introduced?
Priya: no new errors in logs. CPU utilization per GPU node increased a bit due to larger batches but still within limits.
Marta: go ahead and ramp to 50% if stable. Also set a soft rate limit for LaunchPad embeddings to 60% of normal while we stabilize.
Alex: infractl param-set --pool pool-us-east-1-all --param continuous_batch_window_us=50000 --param max_batch_size=64 --rollout=50% --meta "ramp after canary"
deploy-bot: starting rollout to 50%...
Sam (oncall): support pinged LaunchPad and posted to #support-status.
incident-bot: note: on-call handoff at 16:30 UTC scheduled (Sam -> Nate).
Sam (oncall): handing off active incident to Nate in 30 mins. I'll leave controls with deploy lock removed for Nate.
Nate: thanks. I'm going to add a temporary per-org quota throttle via gateway: gatewayctl set-quota launchpad_prod --requests-per-minute 3000 --note "temporary throttle during mitigation"
Alex: throttle applied.
Priya: monitoring shows overall system p99 down ~260ms from peak; LaunchPad p50 increased ~40ms (expected). Errors dropped 35%.
Marta: good tradeoff. Can we keep streaming disabled for the org and add an eval to check user experience?
Sam (oncall): yes, disable streaming flag applied: api-gateway header X-Disable-Streaming: true for launchpad_prod.
Nate: we should record the exact changes for postmortem: continuous_batch_window_us +40000, max_batch_size +32, streaming disabled, gateway throttle set to 60% of baseline, rollout percentages and timestamps.
Alex: logged config changes in infra audit: https://internal.logs/changes/1938888123 (private).
Sam (oncall): any customer-impacting errors left?
Priya: no new 5xx. Token rate slightly delayed for some interactive workloads but acceptable.
Marta: set follow-up action: investigate request fanout pattern from LaunchPad, add adaptive per-client batching caps so a single org can't push window to extreme.
Sam (oncall): agreed. I'll open an action item: ACTION-1938: auto-adapt max_batch_size & window based on per-org concurrency.
Nate: leaving this in Nate's queue post-handoff. Also recommend we add an automated runbook step to consider per-org soft throttles earlier.
Sam (oncall): handing off now — Nate, taking control. I will stay on until stable. :thumbsup:
Nate: thanks Sam. I'll continue monitoring and start post-incident notes once stable for 30 minutes.
incident-bot: incident annotated: mitigation applied, customer impact reduced, postmortem required if incident > 1hr.
Alex: rollback plan prepared: infractl param-set ... --param continuous_batch_window_us=10000 --param max_batch_size=32 --rollout=100% if rollback needed.
Sam (oncall): closing communication loop with support and engineering leads. We'll keep streaming flag off for LaunchPad for 2 hours then reassess.
Nate: closing thread — will file a short postmortem and link configs. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
